symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows payment-service receiving HTTP 429 TooManyRequests from gateway-mock on POST /authorize (D20, D22: 6 requests), with 6 orders FAILED and payment WARN logs saying gateway rejected payment with 429 (D40-D41). gateway-mock itself shows no errors and healthy latency (D35-D37, D45-D46). Calls that succeed show 200s (D21, D23). Gateway refuses requests it receives, so root cause is gateway-mock rejecting with an error answer (rate limiting).
